names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Σίμων Επίσκοπος Βλαδιμίρ και Σουζδαλίας», with the rank word and the see left off. No Slavonic form is recorded: saint.gr prints none.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Σίμων, την παραμονή της κοιμήσεώς του, το 1226 μ.Χ., έλαβε το μέγα αγγελικό σχήμα», and the head line of the same page gives «(; - 1226)». The page gives no year for his birth, only that he became a monk in the second half of the twelfth century.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). He is a Russian saint and that calendar is the one that would settle his own day; it was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Σίμων Επίσκοπος Βλαδιμίρ και Σουζδαλίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is not `simon-the-zealot`**, whose Greek row comes off this very same day page: that is the apostle, this is a thirteenth-century Russian bishop, and the two share nothing but the name and the day. **Two saints are named in his vision and only one has a folder**: the venerable Theodosius is `theodosius-of-the-kyiv-caves` and is linked; the venerable Antony beside him has no folder in this corpus and is named without a link. **`locations` are left out** although Vladimir, Suzdal and the Kyiv Caves are all named: the see is in `office` and the rest are a monastery, a burial and a translation. **The relic is recorded in the note and not as a claim of incorruption of this reader's own**: «Το Λείψανο του Αγίου βρίσκεται αδιάφθορο στη Λαύρα των Σπηλαίων του Κιέβου». No hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
